original_test_intent: Build the approved CUDA samples nbody application and run its benchmark on the intended NVIDIA GPU with 300,000 bodies and 10,000 iterations, requiring a valid PASS/result and a healthy usable SUT afterward.
original_method: Pin CUDA samples revision and compatible CUDA/NVCC/build packages; map GPU UUID/BDF to selector; check memory/time/thermal feasibility; preserve baseline and isolate jobs; build reproducibly; execute nbody in foreground or tracked job with exact parameters, telemetry, timeout and abort rules; capture complete result/score/exit; stop children and compare GPU/driver/log/final usability.
manual_activity: Operator supplies supported source/toolchain and expected result, maps the GPU and approves package changes and sustained load; agent may build/run under the approved sandbox and controls.
required_inputs: Pinned CUDA samples commit/archive/hash and license/source policy
Compatible CUDA toolkit/NVCC/driver/OS and exact build dependencies
Approved n=300000, i=10000 resource budget and expected PASS/score baseline
Isolated SUT, package/install approval, telemetry limits and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not clone latest or install overlapping distro/vendor CUDA packages blindly
Never assume device index 0 maps to intended GPU
Track PID/children; do not leave a background workload
Abort on OOM, XID, thermal/power, link or management anomaly
Preserve logs and remove only approved build/test artifacts
agent_execution_scope: Build in approved location and run tracked exact workload
engineer_actions: Own recovery from driver or hardware anomaly

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic benchmark language omits source exact build and parameters; a cross-vendor reference is not in the Master Criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Build the pinned nbody sample with the approved toolchain and run `./nbody -benchmark -device=<mapped selector> -n=300000 -i=10000` as a tracked process, capturing complete output and telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Benchmark mode, n=300000, i=10000 and 60-minute estimates are preserved; device 0 is remapped by verified identity.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a reproducible build manifest and bind the benchmark PID, GPU UUID, exact argv, result/score and telemetry to one run journal.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates floating dependencies and orphaned background execution while retaining the intended workload.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful compile or generic GPU stress cannot substitute for nbody's numeric/result output.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Ten thousand iterations may exceed the nominal hour depending on GPU and build; enforce an approved timeout without calling timeout a DUT failure automatically.

project_override_considerations: Application owner supplies canonical nbody revision, expected PASS/score fields and any performance threshold for the platform.
expected_evidence: Exact argv, PID lifecycle, stdout/stderr, exit and nbody PASS/score
Cleanup and final GPU/host usability plus engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently specifies CUDA samples nbody and exact workload parameters; missing revision, target mapping and expected score are project inputs, while DeepSeek's generic baseline is not authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Required packages, source and acceptance inputs are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Makes the build/run reproducible, ties device selection to physical identity and closes the background-process and evidence gaps.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU ordinal values can change with enumeration and environment variables, so `device=0` is not durable identity. Unpinned CUDA samples and duplicate toolkit package sources can change build behavior or break an installed driver. Backgrounding hides exit and cleanup, while a benchmark may print both a score and a validation result; both complete output and process status are necessary to interpret the case.
